profile.Name: Scorched One King
profile.Personality: Little is known of him. His sect follows the old teachings of the first skin bandits and will not accept that any other race could be superior to Skeletons.
profile.Backstory: He leads the Scorched Ones from Kombust in the Burning Forest. His followers have sworn to skin and destroy the 'lesser races', and their writings speak of staying hidden in the forest until they can restore Skeletons to their former glory.
profile.SpeechQuirks: No speech of his own is recorded.
